signature.name: Kapaleeshwarar Temple
signature.detail: A classic Dravidian temple with a towering gopuram and lively rituals, it is Chennai's most iconic sight. Visit early morning or late afternoon to avoid heat and crowds; dress modestly (shoulders and knees covered) and leave shoes at the entrance.

signature.name: Marina Beach
signature.detail: One of the longest urban beaches in the world, it is the city's social heart and a must for sunset strolls. Go in the evening when locals gather; swimming is not advised due to strong currents.

signature.name: Fort St. George
signature.detail: The first English fortress in India, now housing a museum and colonial-era buildings. It is closed on Fridays; allow an hour to explore the museum and ramparts.

signature.name: San Thome Basilica
signature.detail: A striking white neo-Gothic basilica built over the tomb of St. Thomas, a key Christian pilgrimage site. Open daily; dress respectfully and visit the small museum.

signature.name: Government Museum Chennai
signature.detail: One of India's oldest museums, with a renowned bronze gallery and archaeological finds. Closed on Fridays; the bronze collection is a highlight.

signature.name: Valluvar Kottam
signature.detail: A memorial to the Tamil poet Thiruvalluvar, featuring a massive stone chariot and an auditorium. Best visited in the cooler evening; combine with a trip to nearby Mylapore.
